text:
jordan: FYI customer wants BYOK cross-region cutover next week (eu, us). we need RBAC tweaks, audit retention confirmation, and a KMS-proxy behavior change for attestation blobs. quick sync?
maria: timeline? is this a live migrate or double-write?
sam: plan from customer: generate new HSM-wrapped key in eu, attest, import into proxy in us as canary, then flip traffic. keep previous wrapped version available for 48h.
ida: compliance note: some customers need 7y immutable audit retention; others are 2y. can proxy support per-tenant retention & S3 object-lock mirror?
jordan: must. also need proof-of-possession chain in key metadata (attestation blob + nonce + attestor cert id).
maria: RBAC: we should not grant broad kms:importKey. propose ephemeral scoped role `temp-rewrap` issued by vault-auth with ttl=45m and require a second approver. logging should show approver id too.
sam: agree. implementation: issue ephemeral JWT with claims {sub, tenant, actions:[kms:import,kms:attach], exp}. activation gated by approval ticket id. sample flow: `POST /auth/ephemeral` -> approver approves -> `PATCH /auth/ephemeral/:id/activate`
ida: vuln triage: vendor posts firmware CVE. do we pause all imports until vendor patch validated? i propose: deny new imports to affected HSM model, set wrapping-only to be blocked, run integrity verification on keys recently imported. escalate to sec oncall.
jordan: practical ops: maintain dual-wrap state: each key record keeps list of wrapped-material entries with fields: region, wrap-alg, attestation-ref, import-timestamp, operator. ledger needs append-only semantics.
maria: for tamper-evidence we should batch-sign ledger segments with a service signing key and push to both internal SIEM and customer's archival bucket with object-lock (governance). also mirror to kinesis for real-time monitoring.
sam: logging details required by compliance: operator display name, operator-id, operation (wrap/import/rotate/revoke), hsm-firmware (full string), attestation-blob-ref, session-id, nonce, request-id. store as structured JSON event and also ASCII human-readable note in activity feed.
ida: incident requirements: if we suspect exposure, checklist: 1) freeze imports and wraps; 2) verify attestation signatures for all imports in window; 3) snapshot HSM audit logs and firmware; 4) compare ledger hash chain to backup mirror; 5) rotate dependent keys if integrity fails.
jordan: question about attestation storage: do we persist the raw attestation blob in key metadata or only an immutable pointer to customer S3? pros/cons?
maria: prefer pointer + local content-addressed cache. raw blob in customer-owned S3 (if they want custody) and a sha256 pointer in metadata. ensures we don't hold sensitive artifacts longer than needed.
sam: for customers that request chain-of-custody from us, we keep an immutable copy in our archive (encrypted) and add customer-consent flag. retention controlled by tenant policy.
ida: RBAC nuance: approvals must be done by someone outside the ops team performing the rewrap to avoid four-eyes bypass. enforce via approver group membership check in policy.
jordan: operational blockers before cutover: 1) ephemeral-role automation and approval UI 2) add attestation pointer to key schema + storage pipeline 3) append-only ledger export + signing 4) per-tenant retention plumbing to S3 with object-lock.
maria: assign: sam -> runbook + event schema; jordan -> ledger signing + export; ida -> compliance wording + retention mapping; i'll own RBAC changes and PR for proxy behavior.
sec-bot: ticket created SEC-4510: BYOK cross-region cutover RBAC/audit work; status: triage required :spiral_note_pad:
ida: can we add a fast key-integrity probe to the runbook? hash(public-wrapped-material) compare to pre-import baseline, fail => quarantine.
sam: yes, add probe step and audit delta report. rolling window should be 24h for canary.
maria: thanks team. let's keep detailed logs here. i'll open the RBAC PR and ping for approvals. finish items by EOD Wednesday to be ready for Thurs cutover. :thumbsup:
